query:
WITH Graduated2021_2025 AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    graduation_date,
    major_name,
    major_classification_name,
    major_classification_parent_name
  FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala
  WHERE qualification IN ('بكالوريوس', 'ماجستير', 'دكتوراه', 'زمالة')
    AND graduation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND YEAR(graduation_date) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
),
EmploymentStats AS (
  SELECT 
    g.major_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) AS total_graduates,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN j.job_start_date IS NOT NULL 
      AND j.job_start_date >= g.graduation_date 
      AND j.job_start_date <= DATE_ADD(g.graduation_date, 365) 
      THEN g.id 
    END) AS employed_within_year,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN j.job_start_date IS NOT NULL 
        AND j.job_start_date >= g.graduation_date 
        AND j.job_start_date <= DATE_ADD(g.graduation_date, 365) 
        THEN g.id 
      END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT g.id), 2
    ) AS employment_rate
  FROM Graduated2021_2025 g
  LEFT JOIN estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala j ON g.id = j.id
  GROUP BY g.major_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) >= 10
),
LowEmploymentMajors AS (
  SELECT major_name, employment_rate
  FROM EmploymentStats
  WHERE employment_rate < 50
),
GraduatesOfLowEmploymentMajors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.id, g.major_name, g.graduation_date
  FROM Graduated2021_2025 g
  INNER JOIN LowEmploymentMajors l ON g.major_name = l.major_name
),
LatestJobs AS (
  SELECT id, job_title, job_start_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY job_start_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala
  WHERE job_title IS NOT NULL
    AND job_title NOT IN ('لا ينطبق', 'غير معرف', 'غير معروف')
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%رقيب%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%نقيب%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%جندي%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%عريف%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%ملازم%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%عميد%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%لواء%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%عقيد%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%مقدم%'
    AND job_title NOT LIKE '%ضابط%'
)
SELECT 
  TRIM(lj.job_title) AS job_title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) AS graduate_count
FROM GraduatesOfLowEmploymentMajors g
INNER JOIN LatestJobs lj ON g.id = lj.id AND lj.rn = 1
GROUP BY TRIM(lj.job_title)
ORDER BY graduate_count DESC
LIMIT 10
